_about: Animation splice recipes (tools/splice.py; format in its docstring). Clip names and frame numbers only, no animation data. Every recipe is built as a CLIPS library row `s<recipe>` so it can be viewed; only a recipe with "wired": true replaces its target row(s). All three below are EXAMPLES from _build/goku-xv2/repick-shortlists.md ideas: not wired, not shipped, until the owner picks one.

utilt_windup_strike.note: EXAMPLE (shortlist item 2): ATC_027 rising windup, ATC_004 overhead uppercut strike, then back to the floating idle. hit mark = ATC_004 f12 (the R hand rising) lands on output f10, inside utilt's window f8-12. 29 frames = the row's length.

dair_thrust_hold.note: EXAMPLE (shortlist item 6): ATC_024 f2-14 (knee tuck, then the R foot thrust down, stopping before the turn-around kick) with the extended leg held to the row's 39 frames. hit mark = f8 (foot at -6.5) on output f6, the start of dair's first window.

bair_crossport_keep.note: EXAMPLE (the shipped bair kept as a cross-port segment): Luigi's AttackAirB retargeted on Goku, f0-29, with its thigh-stretch bone-scale track. Baked alone it must equal the existing cross-port row exactly; add segments around it (an XV2 lead-in, a mirrored copy) to splice onto it.
